hook: Google just made AI agents use its own servers.
hookText: AI agents must use Google's servers

beats.say: On the twenty-fourth of November, Google made its eight Workspace MCP servers generally available, and added a new clause to its API terms.
From the first of February, twenty twenty-seven, any tool that is, or is driven by, an AI agent must reach Gmail, Drive and Calendar through those servers.
The Gmail server can search, read and draft mail, but it cannot send a message, reply, or forward, and those tools need partner access.
